name: Winlogon Helper DLL Registered for Persistence
description: Detects the registration of a Winlogon helper DLL. This is a powerful persistence mechanism that loads a malicious DLL into the high-privileged winlogon.exe process at logon.

action.description: A Winlogon-related key (Notify, Userinit, Shell) was modified, indicating a potential high-privilege persistence attempt.

operational_usage: This is a high-confidence indicator of a sophisticated persistence technique. Legitimate modifications to these keys are extremely rare. SIEM should treat this as a critical alert and investigate the newly added DLL or executable path.
false_positive: Very rare. Some remote access tools or specific authentication software might legitimately modify these keys, but it should be a known and documented behavior.
